description: hexa learns from its own record and gives better models bigger work

specs.given: hexa is configured with ADR-2610221834 implemented
specs.then: fixes are applied in parallel worktrees, tested first, and the operator's tree remains untouched

specs.description: Harden never touches the operator's working tree
specs.given: The operator's tree holds an uncommitted edit to a file a confirmed finding cites
specs.then: The fix is written in its own worktree; the operator's uncommitted edit is unchanged when the run ends

specs.description: Findings are clustered by cause before they are fixed
specs.given: verify phase confirms 9 findings, 6 of which share a root cause
specs.when: hexa harden proceeds to fix phase
specs.then: the 6 findings are grouped into one cluster and fixed with a shared change

specs.description: Findings are clustered by cause before they are fixed
specs.given: verify phase confirms 9 findings, each with a unique root cause
specs.when: hexa harden proceeds to fix phase
specs.then: each finding is fixed individually as today

specs.given: a cluster of findings is fixed with a shared helper
specs.then: a rule is proposed in .hexa/ADR-rules.toml, a lesson is stored in hexa memory, and a class test is written

specs.given: a cluster of findings is fixed with a shared helper, but no pattern can be generalized
specs.then: only a lesson is stored in hexa memory, and no rule or class test is written

specs.description: What hexa learned goes into what it asks next
specs.given: a project has lessons and rules stored
specs.when: hexa hunt, do run, build, or generate test is run
specs.then: the prompt includes the relevant lessons and rules, ordered and cached per ADR-2610281516 §3
only the focused check is run across all targets

specs.description: A focus keeps verify and the gate
specs.given: `hexa harden --focus "<what to look for>" <target>` whose focus lens reports a finding that verify refutes
specs.then: The refuted finding is not fixed, and every fix that is attempted is gated as without a focus

specs.description: The size of the work follows the measured model
specs.given: a model has a record of N first-time passes and M failures
specs.then: the batch size is adjusted based on the model's record, printed in the opening lines

specs.description: The size of the work follows the measured model
specs.given: a model has a record of 10 first-time passes and 0 failures
specs.then: the model is given larger batches, up to the whole pool

specs.description: The size of the work follows the measured model
specs.given: a model has a record of 0 first-time passes and 10 failures
specs.then: the model is given smaller batches, down to one

specs.description: The gate, verify, and red-test rule never scale down
specs.given: a model is given larger batches
specs.then: the gate, verify step, and red-test rule remain unchanged

specs.description: The gate, verify, and red-test rule never scale down
specs.given: a model is given larger batches
specs.then: each fix is still tested with a full gate before landing

specs.description: A fix that fails the full gate never lands, whatever the record
specs.given: A model with a perfect record, given the whole pool as one batch, one of whose fixes fails the full gate
specs.then: That fix does not land; the record changed the batch size, not the check

specs.description: Rules that do not touch the target paths stay out of the prompt
specs.given: A project with a stored `lesson:*` entry and two rules, one matching the target path and one matching only paths outside it
specs.then: The hunt prompt includes the lesson and the matching rule and does not include the rule that touches no target path

specs.description: A lens a lesson covers becomes a targeted check
specs.given: A project with `lesson:async-staleness` naming a class of call site, and a target with 3 such call sites
specs.then: The prompt carries the lesson, and the lens it covers asks to verify that these 3 call sites follow `lesson:async-staleness` rather than an open hunt
